Excerpted, muted and transcoded for the Foxglade motion study. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Red_fox_(Vulpes_vulpes)_looking_for_a_mouse.webm | https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
source.preprocessing: RGB; ImageNet mean/std; 1.25 padded square affine crop; input 256x256 from ONNX tensor, not stale 192x256 deploy metadata

limitations: Single-view estimated 2D points, not 3D motion capture.
Pretrained RTMPose ran inference; its pose network was not retrained here.
Only Fourier timing parameters were fit locally; no game policy was trained.
Chronological same-clip holdout is not independent-animal validation.
Occluded paws may be misidentified, and confidence is not calibrated probability.
Existing rig clips remain authored animations. No paw contact or bone rotation is derived.
No physical metres-per-second can be recovered without camera/scale calibration.
